lamellar_exclusion.quadratic_budget: Every degree-N configuration with exact one-coordinate lamellar square-wave sign has W_N=Omega(N^3), so no likelihood supported on that class satisfies E W_N=O(N^2)
lamellar_exclusion.k1541_compatible_branch: If a sequence or mixture in the class also satisfies K1541's nonvanishing expected fixed-ratio ultraviolet sign-shell condition, then E W_N=Omega(N^4)
lamellar_exclusion.capacity_position: The family fails in the multiplication term before any relative-Fisher or Gaussian weighted boundary-capacity contribution is counted
lamellar_exclusion.surviving_route: A surviving endpoint must use non-lamellar geometry or a likelihood distributed across textures in a way not represented by concentration near one Fourier-truncated square-wave center
lamellar_exclusion.scope_guard: No arbitrary three-dimensional sign texture, universal endpoint capacity, unrestricted ground-energy asymptotic, continuum interacting BRST operator or source-owned GU Hamiltonian is decided
